crossRefs.note: David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
crossRefs.keyword: A.M. 2993. B.C. 1011. An. Ex. Is. 480. Achish

crossRefs.note: David arose, and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
crossRefs.keyword: A.M. 2993. B.C. 1011. An. Ex. Is. 480. Achish

crossRefs.note: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam…
crossRefs.keyword: A.M. 2993. B.C. 1011. An. Ex. Is. 480. Achish

people.name: Achish
people.line: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Maoch
people.line: Father of Achish, king of Gath.

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”
translations.bsb: After three years, however, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish son of Maacah, king of Gath. And Shimei was told, “Look, your slaves are in Gath.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
translations.asv: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants are in Gath.
